title: xanthisma wigginsii
intro: Xanthisma wigginsii, commonly known as Wiggins' brittle prickly phacelia, is a rare flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in herbal medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote coughing to expel mucus. Research on Xanthisma wigginsii has identified bioactive constituents including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
